name: 小雪初晴
group_note: 小雪初晴, branded in-game 'SnowMud', a Wen Ruian (温瑞安)-novel-themed MUD by CuteRabbit Studio (JackyBoy) for CCTX & SDXL. WASM pass fixed a genuine blocking bug: the adm/etc/ directory does not exist anywhere in this archive (confirmed absent even in raw/), so logind.lpc's very first write_file(USERS, ...) call (visitor-counter increment, executed on EVERY connection before the id prompt) threw 'Wrong permissions for opening file /adm/etc/users for overwrite, No such file or directory' -- write_file() can create a missing FILE but not a missing DIRECTORY, so this was an uncaught error on every single connection, and the driver silently swallowed it and dumped the raw connection straight into an interactive command prompt without ever calling input_to() for registration (every subsequent input showed as an unrecognized '什么？' command). This would have failed identically on a native boot, not just under WASM. Fixed by creating libs/xxcq/work/adm/etc/ with bootstrapped users/iduser counter files (both '0'). Also confirmed via source (§7.56 dual-file caution) that SECURITY_D actually points at /adm/daemons/securd, NOT the decoy .../securityd.lpc that references the (unused in this codebase) WIZLIST text file -- securd.lpc bootstraps its admin account via a hardcoded set('wiz_status/jackyboy', '(admin)') call in restore_list() (same shape as the sj lib fixed earlier in this pass) rather than reading a wizlist file; added set('wiz_status/fluffos', '(admin)') alongside it. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 select -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> temporary password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and admin permission '目前权限：(admin)' already showing in the connection banner, plus a '【天神】' top-tier title, zero unexpected errors. LPC formatter run across all 2886 .lpc files (2828 written, 28 errors, 30 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. The one map.lpc file present confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to its pre-format blob. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
